floor.note: EVAL-90 consumes both underlyings' trade-tape IV surfaces and both perp series. protocol.title: Cross-sectional near-ATM IV basis (BTC-vs-ETH relative near-ATM IV) -> subsequent relative *vol-of-vol* spread (BTC-minus-ETH forward std(squared log returns)): wrapper-free Spearman rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-77 (same cross-sectional BTC-vs-ETH surface basis and aligned common-bar reconstruction, reused verbatim; atm_iv basis) and EVAL-84 (forward vol-of-vol definition std(squared log returns), reused verbatim) but a DISTINCT target: the forward relative vol-of-vol *spread* (BTC minus ETH), not the relative RV spread (EVAL-77), not the relative return direction (EVAL-88), not the relative VRP spread (EVAL-89), not own-asset vol-of-vol (EVAL-84); no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the relative-value *vol-of-vol* complement to EVAL-84 (own-asset term_slope -> vol-of-vol) and a distinct cell from EVAL-77 (relative-vol spread), EVAL-88 (relative direction), and EVAL-89 (relative VRP spread). It makes a predictiveness claim only, no traded-form / monetization claim

cross_section.target: y_k = Vov_BTC(k) - Vov_ETH(k) with Vov_i(k) = sqrt(mean((v_j - mean(v))^2)), v_j = r_j^2, r_j = log(close_j/close_{j-1}) over next H perp bars (forward relative vol-of-vol spread)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM implied vol surface (EVAL-71 build_surface_bars) for BTC and ETH; the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e61.expanding_zscore via EVAL-77). The atm_iv basis is used (a vol level, not inside the vol-of-vol target), distinct from EVAL-89's skew basis.
protocol.target_detail: forward relative vol-of-vol = per underlying vol-of-vol sqrt(mean((v_j - mean(v))^2)) with v_j = r_j^2 (squared log returns) over the next H perp bars (strictly after the decision at bar k, EVAL-84 definition on EVAL-77 aligned common closes), then BTC minus ETH on the common aligned bar grid
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, y_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, ETH iv-richness predicts BTC carries the richer forward vol-of-vol — relative turbulence)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the relative-vol-of-vol spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if at least one config (atm_iv basis x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
